item.title: Can Copyright Survive the Age of A.I.?
item.description: American University’s Linda Bloss-Baum examines how A.I. is stress-testing the foundations of U.S. copyright law. As litigation, licensing negotiations and classroom debates unfold simultaneously, Bloss-Baum argues that the future of innovation depends on preserving meaningful power and compensation for the creators whose work underpins the A.I. economy.

item.title: Paul Singer’s Toyota Campaign Tests the Limits of Japan’s Corporate Tradition
item.description: By forcing Toyota to raise its takeover bid for Toyota Industries, Paul Singer delivered a major activist victory in Japan’s corporate stronghold.

item.title: Sotheby’s Opens the London Spring Marquee Sales With a £131M White-Glove Night
item.description: The auction house's solid, carefully staged £131 million performance suggests that renewed market confidence is holding despite the turbulence unfolding beyond the saleroom.

item.title: The Best Men’s Running Shoes, From Carbon-Plated Rockets to Everyday Workhorses
item.description: The foam arms race is just getting started. Here's what to lace up when the weather finally cooperates.

item.title: Netflix Leaves WBD Fight With $2.8B and a New Identity Question
item.description: After losing WBD to Paramount Skydance, Netflix walks away with $2.8 billion but faces new questions about its next phase of growth.

item.title: “Abstract Expressionists: The Women” Adds an Essential Chapter to the Movement’s History
item.description: The show revisits the contributions of 32 visionary artists who helped expand the language of Abstract Expressionism beyond its early centers.

item.title: In Pursuit of Powder: Catskiing Colorado’s Remote Irwin Backcountry
item.description: Near Crested Butte, Irwin's remote terrain turns catskiing into a day of untouched powder, high-altitude nerves and triumphant après.

item.title: Apple TV Chief Eddy Cue Brings His Formula 1 Passion to Streaming and Apps
item.description: Apple’s services chief Eddy Cue is betting big on Formula 1, launching U.S. race coverage on Apple TV and weaving the sport across Apple’s ecosystem.

item.title: Karen Gunderson and the Subtle Complexity of Black
item.description: She's known for deftly translating the rhythms of moving water into carefully constructed two-dimensional compositions using a palette of blacks.

item.title: Crypto Has Been Renting Access to the Financial System. Kraken Just Bought In.
item.description: Paybis’ Konstantins Vasilenko analyzes a breakthrough that could reshape how digital asset firms interact with the traditional financial system. Vasilenko explains why Kraken Financial’s newly granted Federal Reserve master account—and direct access to Fedwire—may mark a structural turning point for crypto payments.
